newsitem.title: UK: Graseby says outlook firm, shares respond.
newsitem.headline: Graseby says outlook firm, shares respond.

text.p: British electronic instruments group Graseby Plc made preliminary comments on its trading for the first nine months of its financial year on Tuesday and said group sales were up 10 percent.
With sales firm across the group, the company said its performance in the second half was likely to be similar to the first half "and reflects a substantial improvement over the second half of 1995".

The group also said it prospects for 1997 were encouraging, and it predicted supplies of chemical agent systems on order from the US and Switzerland would "begin to have a significant impact on shipments commencing in late 1997".
Following the news its shares rose by 8 pence, or 6.0 percent, to 141-1/2 pence by 0930 GMT.
